records.name: Runway 14/32 pavement (CLOSED) — FTY
records.note: CLOSED runway (FAA lists only 8/26; county Master Plan 'Closed Runway 14-32'). Pavement only — NOT an active runway, no active markings. Alignment = Taxiway A's heading-139 line (the closed runway's surviving trace); crossing at (-156, -4203) surveyed from the capture; 1,267 m split at mid-length (split unsurveyed). Profile from the grid with ends held to the field shelf (A2).
